Re: Formal Appeal of Prior Authorization Denial  
Member: Sawyer Iverson  
Member ID: W821798872  
Denial date: August 2, 2026  
Reference number: POC-40E31914E1-52376  
Requested service: Knee arthroscopy with meniscus surgery  
CPT: 29881  
Surgeon: Reyes, MD

Dear Grievances and Appeals Department:

I appeal the denial of prior authorization for CPT 29881. The denial states that the submitted documentation was incomplete and did not allow a determination of medical necessity.

The enclosed records address the medical necessity of the requested procedure:

- I have had 14 months of progressive knee pain that has not resolved with rest.
- I completed 18 supervised physical-therapy visits over 16 weeks, from February 25, 2026, through June 17, 2026. Treatment focused on quadriceps strengthening and range of motion, and the physical-therapy discharge note documents the completed course.
- I used NSAIDs for four months without adequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on April 19, 2026, provided only three weeks of partial relief.
- MRI performed on May 30, 2026, showed a displaced bucket-handle tear of the medial meniscus with mechanical locking. The MRI also showed preserved articular cartilage and Kellgren-Lawrence grade 1 changes.
- I experience locking and giving way, cannot squat or kneel, and am limited to level walking.
- Examination showed positive provocative testing on the affected side and range of motion limited by pain.
- There is no active infection or untreated substance use. My BMI is 29, and I am a nonsmoker.

These records document a structural meniscal injury with mechanical symptoms, persistent functional impairment, failure of substantial conservative treatment, and inadequate response to medication and injection therapy. They also provide the imaging, treatment history, examination findings, functional limitations, and relevant risk information needed to evaluate the request.

Please overturn the denial and approve the requested knee arthroscopy with meniscus surgery. If the request remains denied, please identify precisely which required records or clinical facts are still missing and provide the specific medical-necessity criteria applied to CPT 29881 in this determination.

I have not quoted a CPT 29881-specific medical policy because the publicly available MHS/Ambetter clinical-policy materials do not identify or publish a specific knee-arthroscopy policy or the detailed criteria applied to this request. Those materials indicate that criteria from a separate clinical decision-support source may be used when no MHS policy exists. Please provide the exact criteria, source, version or edition, and clinical rationale used for reference number POC-40E31914E1-52376.

Please acknowledge receipt of this appeal and the enclosed records. I request that all submitted clinical documentation be reviewed by an appropriate orthopedic physician or other clinician qualified to evaluate knee meniscal surgery.

Sincerely,

Sawyer Iverson  
Member ID: W821798872
